fees.description: Disconnection fee - applicable when energy is disconnected to the property.
Reconnection fee - applicable when energy is reconnected to the property.
Special meter read (including moving in and moving out of your supply address).
Late Payment Fee may be applied, if applicable (GST is not applicable).
Direct Debit Rejection Fee (GST is not applicable).
Payment processing fee may apply to payments made by credit card (GST inclusive). Not applicable after 1 October 2026.
Payment processing fee may apply to payments made by debit card (GST inclusive). Not applicable after 1 October 2026.

electricityContract.terms: A copy of the Market Retail Contract is provided and can be seen on our website. Refer to https://www.actewagl.com.au/legal/pricing-information/your-rights-and-obligations.

discounts.description: All customers will receive a 50% discount off their electricity supply charges, applied to each quarterly electricity invoice for a benefit period of 12 months. Discount does not apply to any Greenchoice electricity charges, Carbon Neutral Gas Offset charges or miscellaneous fees and charges; and will not apply to any government taxes, fees, levies or charges. For further information, refer to https://www.actewagl.com.au/NSW-Standard-electricity-prices-July-2026.

electricityContract.variation: If we vary our market offer prices or miscellaneous fees and charges, we will notify you at least five business days before the variation in the tariffs and charges are to apply to you; and deliver the notice by your preferred form of communication where you have communicated this to us, or otherwise by the same method as that used for delivery of your bill.

incentives.description: VPP add-on that allows customers to participate in VPP on current plan. Customers with a compatible battery can enrol. In return, customers receive a $60 quarterly credit ($0.597758 ex gst / day). Key details: Customers remain on current plan and covered under existing VPP Services Agreement. Eligibility: compatible battery needed - see website. Existing ActewAGL customers receive a $100 sign up bonus, and new ActewAGL customers receive a $200 sign up bonus. Call 02 5110 2528 for more details.

VPP add-on available only through Electrify with ActewAGL, for customers purchasing eligible batteries through approved installers. This is in addition to the Battery Power Top-Up. In return, customers receive a $20 quarterly credit ($0.1992528 ex gst /day). Key details: customers remain on current plan, $20 quarterly bill credit ($80/year) and covered under the existing VPP Services Agreement. Eligibility: Compatible battery (full list on website) purchased through Electrify with ActewAGL.

eligibility.description: You must be a residential customer and agree to ActewAGL Virtual Power Plant Services Agreement and have an eligible battery storage system. T&Cs apply, refer to https://www.actewagl.com.au/energy-plans/battery-saver.

electricityContract.onExpiryDescription: The benefit period is 1 year. At the end of your benefit period you may be placed on a new pricing plan. We will notify you of any changes at least 20 business days before they take effect.
electricityContract.additionalFeeInformation: For information on additional fees, refer to https://www.actewagl.com.au/legal/pricing-information/charges-and-rates.
